'''George Robin Henderson''' (23 April 1941 – 21 February 2016) was a Scots mathematician with a flair for music. Noted as an inspirational character in his field<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.scotsman.com/news/obituaries/obituary-george-henderson-teacher-mathematician-statistician-1-4132036|title=Obituary: George Henderson – Scotsman Newspaper}}</ref> he taught at Boroughmuir High School, lectured at [[Napier College]], consulted in statistics and published a book.<ref name="Henderson 2011 p. ">{{cite book | last=Henderson | first=G | title=Six Sigma quality improvement with Minitab | publisher=John Wiley & Sons | location=Hoboken, NJ | year=2011 | isbn=978-0-470-74174-0 }}</ref>

At Napier he developed a degree in mathematics and engineering technology. He played cornet and tuba, and through the 1980s and 90s as a member of the MacTaggart Scott Works Band he revived the band and pushed them to have a "positive impact on the community"<ref name=":0" />
